title: A Leatherback Turtle Dived 4,400 Feet, a New Depth Record

scenes.text: A sea turtle dived 4,400 feet straight down.
It's a leatherback, the biggest turtle on Earth.
Scientists tagged it and tracked a dive of at least 1,344 meters.
That's more than three-quarters of a mile down.
It beat the old record of 1,280 meters, set back in 2006.
All that depth, for a jellyfish dinner.

description:
A sea turtle dived 4,400 feet straight down.
A tagged leatherback reached at least 1,344 meters, beating the old record of 1,280 meters set in 2006. Leatherbacks dive to hunt jellyfish.
Would you go that deep for lunch?
first_comment: Deepest dive by any turtle, for a jellyfish. What is the deepest you have gone?
